threshold_rationale: Scaffolding only: the owner must replace every positive threshold and name the reviewed release hardware before release-grade measurements. Values must be justified independently from the runs they judge. The required scale is the enforced 21-validator launch ceiling: ConfigParam16, ConfigParam28, node configuration admission, and Genesis generation all reject larger committees. Inherited Simplex at fork point 628506c9e and the reviewed upstream committee of approximately 400 validators provide prior context for scale selection, but do not close any O-2 measurement gap. The 21-validator requirement follows the enforced launch cap, not a result-derived threshold.
